relationships.subject: painful diabetic neuropathy
relationships.evidence_quote: Functional analysis revealed an important role of the multilayer SLIT-ROBO axis and its regulation with particular involvement of SLIT2, ROBO1, ROBO3 genes that were enriched in epivariants in patients with painful diabetic neuropathy.

key_findings: Epivariant analysis in two PDN vs painless DN cohorts showed enrichment of SLIT/ROBO signaling genes (SLIT2, ROBO1, ROBO3).
HypoEpiMut score was significantly higher in PDN than PLDN in the PROPGER cohort.
